string.text: Replaces New Game Randomize with a two-click D.O.G.M.A. button. Prep sets Story on, Warfare/Azazel/Soulslike off, Veteran + Survivalist, Ironman with 2 lives, and a 1911 in the loadout. Start begins the run (500 RU, ammo kit, 1911 at 50% parts, 1 medkit with 2 uses, 2 yadylin, rebreather). If you change those settings, the button goes back to Prep. Faction, name, and spawn stay as you set them.
